metadata.description: Personal plugin marketplace for AI coding agents

plugins.name: minerva
plugins.description: Durable record discipline for software work — promotion, not accumulation. Proposal → work → replan → promote, with a persistence hierarchy of decisions, proposals, and scratchpads.

plugins.name: lorestrom
plugins.description: minerva's successor: its lifecycle with its records kept in Lorestrom — link a repository to a shared Lorestrom workspace through its MCP server, migrate its .minerva records there, and run propose, work, review, promote, ship and cleanup there. No local file mode; propose-ship and propose-ship-auto run the whole lifecycle, cleanup sweeps other clones' units, and lint checks the knowledge.
